method.workload: 49 objects; frozen nine-stone state; 120 iterations; root CEM keep 32; identical search/physics settings
method.timing: search.search only, fresh process, sequential runs, no warmup search, OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1
method.host_workers: ThreadPoolExecutor; independent reward/observation evaluator caches; ordered results; one workspace per CUDA fidelity
method.scope: CPU native search and CUDA physics unchanged; floor scoring remains serial
method.inputs: Same frozen YAML and trusted state as excavator-cuda-throughput-tuning.json
cautions: Two seeds at evaluation 128/capacity 256; one seed at production evaluation/capacity 32.
The process-local CUDA capacity override is not a change to production GPU capacity.
No claim of CPU/GPU physics parity or long-horizon quality equivalence.
Setup cost is recorded separately and excluded from search time.
